suggestions: I'm grateful for a deploy that went green on the first push, no need to sit there refreshing the pipeline.
I'm thankful for the sound of azan drifting in through the window while I'm finishing up a cup of coffee.
I'm grateful for a code review that actually taught me something instead of just nitpicking semicolons.
I'm thankful for nasi lemak from the mamak that somehow tastes better at 2am after a long shift.
I'm grateful for the rezeki of still having both parents around to call when I don't know what to do.
I'm thankful for a Monday that didn't feel like a Monday because the backlog actually looked manageable.
I'm grateful for a stranger holding the lift door open when I was running late with both hands full of laptop bags.
I'm thankful for the breeze right after Maghrib when the heat of the day finally lets go.
I'm grateful for finally closing that ticket that's been sitting in my board for three sprints.
I'm thankful for my sister sending voice notes instead of texts, somehow it feels less lonely that way.
I'm grateful for a manager who said go home, it can wait, and actually meant it.
I'm thankful for the first sip of air tangan after a long day of back-to-back meetings.
I'm grateful for catching a bug in staging before it ever got near production.
I'm thankful for the empty roads on the drive back from Subuh prayers, just me and the quiet.
I'm grateful for a teammate who covered for me without making it a whole thing.
